strike.name: Strike craft
strike.description: Fighters and bombers: fast squadrons that tear into capital ships, but escorts' flak shreds them.

escort.name: Escort
escort.description: Corvettes and frigates: flak and point defence that hunt strike craft, outgunned by capital ships.

capital.name: Capital ship
capital.description: Destroyers, cruisers and battleships: heavy guns and armour that crush escorts, but too slow to swat strike craft.

station.name: Station
station.description: Fixed defences: no counters either way (bombers' torpedoes still hit them hard).

civilian.name: Civilian
civilian.description: Unarmed or barely armed: no counters either way.

interceptor.name: Interceptor
interceptor.description: Dogfighter: hunts strike craft, bombers above all; little to fear from it for capital ships.

bomber.name: Bomber
bomber.description: Torpedo bomber: devastating against capital ships and stations, nearly harmless to escorts and other strike craft.

ion.name: Ion
ion.description: Ion cannons scramble a target's systems (it loses its next turn) rather than kill it. Works on anything, best on capital ships.
